latin_incipit: Idem est bresith, id est in principio creauit, ac si dixisset in sapientia
latin_full: Idem est bresith, id est in principio creauit, ac si dixisset in sapientia
english_translation:
Bereshit, that is, in the beginning he created, is the same as if he had said,

he created in wisdom.
